lessons.key: ac_gap::when a task done when cites a numeric test count floor 4 phase 6 boss count test annotations per file before marking the task complete not just per world exercise counts
lessons.text: When a task Done-when cites a numeric test-count floor (>=4/phase, >=6/boss), count @Test annotations per file before marking the task complete, not just per-world exercise counts.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::for a numeric boundary rule stated as n throws add a test at exactly n the allowed edge not just above and below it
